trials.claim: Single-purchase lifetime license with no recurring subscription fees
trials.claimQuote: No. In line with standard Vovsoft licensing, SEO Checker is available through a single-purchase lifetime license, meaning there are no recurring monthly or annual subscription fees.
trials.reasoning: The vendor says a purchased license is valid forever with future updates, and a buyer confirms no subscription is needed. The revocation clause for breaking the terms does not show any recurring fee.

exhibits.quote: Failure to abide by these provisions may result in severe legal penalties and will result in revocation of the license which will cause the program to no longer work.
exhibits.argument: The license can be revoked causing the program to stop working, so it is not an unconditional lifetime license.

exhibits.quote: A purchased license will be valid forever and includes future updates, all new functions will be available for existing registered users.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states purchased license is valid forever with future updates, supporting lifetime license with no recurring fees.

exhibits.quote: No needs for a Subscribtion, everything already included.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms no subscription is needed and everything is included in the purchase.

trials.claim: Run unlimited SEO scans directly from Windows PC
trials.claimQuote: SEO Checker lets you run unlimited SEO scans directly from your Windows PC.
trials.reasoning: A buyer says they can perform audits as often as they want, and another confirms it runs on a Windows PC. The page-limit and performance comments do not limit how often scans can be run.

exhibits.quote: The program will scan the website and the whole process will take seconds to minutes depending on the size of the website and the defined page limit.
exhibits.argument: The vendor admits scans are subject to a defined page limit, which contradicts unlimited scans.

exhibits.quote: I've found that it struggles when there are hundreds of pages to analyze, but at this price-point, I can't really fault it!
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports the tool struggles with hundreds of pages, undermining the claim of unlimited scans.

exhibits.quote: I can perform audits as often as I want is "priceless".
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms ability to perform audits as often as wanted, supporting unlimited scans.

exhibits.quote: great software and lightweight on my windows pc i recommend seo checker for windows
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms software runs lightweight on Windows PC, supporting Windows PC use.

trials.claim: No hard crawl limits except computer hardware allows
trials.claimQuote: There are no hard limits, so the software can crawl as many pages as your computer hardware allows.
trials.reasoning: The vendor itself refers to a defined page limit for scans. That directly conflicts with the claim of no hard crawl limits other than hardware.

exhibits.quote: The program will scan the website and the whole process will take seconds to minutes depending on the size of the website and the defined page limit.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states there is a defined page limit, contradicting the claim of no hard limits.

exhibits.quote: I've found that it struggles when there are hundreds of pages to analyze, but at this price-point, I can't really fault it!
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports practical crawl limits at hundreds of pages, contradicting hardware-only limits.

exhibits.quote: There are no limits compared to SAAS solutions and the most important SEO aspects are addressed.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms there are no limits compared to SaaS solutions, supporting no hard crawl limits.

exhibits.quote: Now I can analyze hundreds or thousands of URLs.
exhibits.argument: Testimonial confirms ability to analyze hundreds or thousands of URLs, supporting large-scale crawling.

trials.claim: WebView2 functionality requires Windows 10 version 1709 or later, or Windows 11
trials.claimQuote: Please note that the embedded browser (WebView2) functionality requires Windows 10 version 1709 (Fall Creators Update) or later, or Windows 11.
trials.reasoning: The exhibit only lists general Windows support including older versions; it does not confirm or deny the specific WebView2 version requirement. No exhibit directly addresses WebView2's requirements.

exhibits.quote: Supports: Windows 11, Windows 10, Windows 8/8.1, Windows 7, Windows Vista (32-bit & 64-bit)
exhibits.argument: The vendor advertises support for old Windows versions where the Windows 10 1709 or later WebView2 requirement cannot be met.

trials.claim: No monthly limits and no recurring fees vs cloud crawlers
trials.claimQuote: Cloud-based SEO crawlers restrict your audits with monthly limits and recurring fees.
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm there are no limits compared to SaaS solutions and no subscription is needed. A per-scan page limit does not show a monthly limit or recurring fee.

exhibits.quote: The program will scan the website and the whole process will take seconds to minutes depending on the size of the website and the defined page limit.
exhibits.argument: The vendor discloses a defined page limit, undermining the claim of no limits versus cloud crawlers.

exhibits.quote: There are no limits compared to SAAS solutions and the most important SEO aspects are addressed.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms no limits versus SaaS solutions, supporting no monthly limits claim.

exhibits.quote: No needs for a Subscribtion, everything already included.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms no subscription needed, supporting no recurring fees versus cloud crawlers.

trials.claim: Desktop application for Windows that crawls websites and analyzes on-page SEO data
trials.claimQuote: Vovsoft SEO Checker is a user-friendly desktop application for Windows that crawls websites and analyzes on-page SEO data to help improve search engine visibility.
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes it as a website crawler for small and large sites that analyzes on-page SEO data. Reports that crawling can be slow or struggle on large sites do not contradict that it performs this function.

exhibits.quote: I've found that it struggles when there are hundreds of pages to analyze, but at this price-point, I can't really fault it!
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports the crawler struggles on larger sites, undermining the claim that it crawls websites and analyzes data.

exhibits.quote: Worth Every Dollar But It Takes A Lot Of Time For Crawling.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports crawling takes a lot of time, undermining the claim of effective desktop crawling.

exhibits.quote: Vovsoft SEO Checker is an easy to use website crawler that can efficiently crawl both small and large websites.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes product as website crawler that crawls small and large websites.

exhibits.quote: With this SEO checker tool, you can identify broken links, analyze on-page SEO data, distinguish between internal and external links, and classify links as dofollow or nofollow.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states tool analyzes on-page SEO data, directly supporting the analysis claim.
